title: GenoBERT: A Language Model for Accurate Genotype Imputation
abstract: arXiv:2604.00058v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Genotype imputation enables dense variant coverage for genome-wide association and risk-prediction studies, yet conventional reference-panel methods remain limited by ancestry bias and reduced rare-variant accuracy. We present Genotype Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (GenoBERT), a transformer-based, reference-free framework that tokenizes phased genotypes and uses a self-attention mechanism to capture both short- and long-range linkage disequilibrium (LD) dependencies. Benchmarking on two independent datasets including the Louisiana Osteoporosis Study (LOS) and the 1000 Genomes Project (1KGP) across ancestry groups and multiple genotype missingness levels (5-50%) shows that GenoBERT achieves the highest overall accuracy compared to four baseline methods (Beagle5.4, SCDA, BiU-Net, and STICI). translated_title: GenoBERT：一种用于精准基因型填补的语言模型
translated_abstract: 基因型填补能够为全基因组关联研究和风险预测研究提供密集的变异覆盖，然而传统的参考面板方法仍然受到祖源偏差和稀有变异准确率降低的限制。我们提出了基因型双向编码器表示转换模型（GenoBERT），这是一个基于 Transformer 的、无需参考面板的框架，它将相位分型后的基因型进行分词（tokenize），并利用自注意力机制捕获短程和长程的连锁不平衡（LD）依赖关系。在两个独立数据集上的基准测试——包括路易斯安那骨质疏松症研究（LOS）和 1000 基因组计划（1KGP）——横跨不同祖源群体和多个基因型缺失水平（5-50%），结果表明 GenoBERT 相比四种基线方法（Beagle5.4、SCDA、BiU-Net 和 STICI）取得了最高的总体准确率。在实际的稀疏水平下（缺失率高达 25%），GenoBERT 达到了较高的总体填补准确率（r² ≈ 0...
tldr: GenoBERT 是一种基于 Transformer、无需参考面板的基因型填补语言模型，通过自注意力机制捕获短程与长程连锁不平衡依赖关系，在不同祖源群体和多种缺失水平下均超越现有基线方法。
en_tdlr: GenoBERT is a transformer-based, reference-free language model for genotype imputation that leverages self-attention to capture short- and long-range LD dependencies, achieving superior accuracy over existing methods across ancestry groups and missingness levels.
